اختتمن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَتَمْنَ (iḵtatamna) /ix.ta.tam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اُخْتُتِمْنَ (uḵtutimna) /ux.tu.tim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اِخْتَتِمْنَ (iḵtatimna) /ix.ta.tim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
